about: The editor's running notebook of ongoing storylines. At most 15 threads.

threads.status: Anthropic's Levent Alpoge says a roughly 17-million-line Lean proof exists; community certification of the formal artifact reported 21 Nov with checks outstanding; mathematical explanation pending.
Dragos canary research found leaks at three or more providers; OpenRouter removed 125 endpoints from Zero Data Retention; Together AI disclosed a separate credential leak.
Verstappen won Las Vegas on 22 Nov with a McLaren double podium; Mercedes and Antonelli already hold the titles; Cadillac's second 2027 seat was open at last check.
Kress is interim CEO; Wachtell's Joon H. Kim leads an independent investigation; search snippets say Nvidia reported Q3 on 17 Nov and the board will not reinstate Huang, not yet read in full.
Search results indicate an $83 IPO price and first trading on 19 Nov (ticker ANT); details not yet verified from opened pages.
Last read 12 Nov: prisoner exchange finalised, Europe to join next round; search results mention a possible round around the G20 in Miami and a Trump-Putin APEC meeting, unread.
Trump said on 12 Nov the US does not need a deal; Rezaei denies talks; reports of a possible Vance-Rezaei meeting in Doha.
Burnham said on 9 Nov that no decision had been made; reports of a cut to about 60% for 2030; outcome unconfirmed.
Eisenkot has the mandate to form a government; mandate runs to 6 Dec; Haredi parties reportedly fielding overtures.
Brazil package carries the 2027 front-wing concept; McLaren took second and third in Las Vegas on 22 Nov.
Honda had no root cause for Stroll's battery failures as of 13 Nov; full fix targeted for 2027.
Anthropic Mythos 5.2, OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber and Google Gemini 4 Carbon have restricted cyber variants; a Gemini 4 Neon cyber variant is reportedly rolling out to trusted defenders.
BMA consultants voted for a 48-hour strike on 25 to 26 Nov; one undated report said it was paused for formal talks, unconfirmed.
Brussels summit held 20 Nov; search results report a signed deal, details not read.
Further unauthenticated root PoCs published 11 Nov; vendor said scanning but no successful exploitation; another hotfix expected.
